reviewer: Delegated assistant after original/decoded export/light/dark/checkerboard and both sizes on all eight current containers; independent UX reviewer inspected original anatomy/equipment

checks.name: identity
checks.observation: Viewed original and decoded runtime: one adult standing in a split stance with raised bent elbows and rope ends beside the face at a cable station. The intended face-pull position is recognizable.

checks.name: style-consistency
checks.observation: Compared with the previously inspected unchanged approved front-plank master: muted blue-gray top, terracotta leggings, hair bun, natural proportions and softly shaded educational finish are consistent. Gray shoes and tower have no visible branding.

checks.name: pose-and-contact-readability
checks.observation: Figure has two complete arms/hands and legs/shoes, upright trunk and a planted split stance. No obvious duplicated limb or disconnected body joint observed. This does not validate exercise form.

checks.name: equipment-continuity
checks.observation: Both visible rope runs converge at the nearer hand; the rounded end in the far hand beside the ear has no traceable rope connection. Full-size light/dark composites and cropped rope detail retain the defect. An independent reviewer also found this connection unclear/material. Regenerate with one distinct continuous rope branch visibly reaching each hand in front of the face.

checks.name: alpha-and-decoded-edges
checks.observation: Viewed source/export light and dark composites, decoded checkerboard and all eight current container colors at both sizes. No distracting red fringe from the transparency display is visible in these decoded composites. Frame openings and surroundings remain transparent. Source has faint outlying alpha; nonzero alpha reaches y0 with top-row maximum10.

checks.name: usage-framing
checks.observation: Viewed helper source/runtime 256x144 and 320x180 panels and all eight current-container composites at each size. The tower visually touches the top and fails the generous-margin brief: visible alpha>=128 starts y4 and alpha>=250 starts y5 of941 (~0.8-1dp in180 frame). This measurement does not prove the solid tower cap is cut off; it establishes effectively absent upper margin. Far-hand connection remains unreadable at small sizes.

checks.name: interface-remnants
checks.observation: No readable text, weight numbers, labels, arrows, scenery, UI, app controls, phone frame, logo or watermark observed.

limitations: Candidate needs creative revision for rope connection and framing; it is not eligible for promotion based on this review.
Raw alpha bbox [41,0,1481,926]; threshold128 bbox [278,4,1348,915]; threshold250 bbox [279,5,1347,914]. Faint alpha reaches the canvas edge, but solid tower clipping is not asserted.
Visual pose and equipment observations do not clinically validate exercise technique or mechanically certify equipment.
Untagged source explicitly interpreted as sRGB under the profile; no embedded sRGB or color conversion claimed.
Deterministic usage boards use current presentation.json container colors; they do not establish native/RN/device rendering, text/control contrast or signed-phone acceptance.
No human artwork or activation approval recorded and no production promotion performed.
